# Local typefaces

Barlow Condensed 600 is used for display headings and arcade numbers. IBM Plex Mono 400 is used for addresses and tabular data. Both Latin WOFF2 files are bundled by the static build; no font service is called at runtime.

These files continue the type choices in the Wheelkeepers project. The upstream files were retrieved from xqsy/wheelkeepers commit 03a1b92e82a3f48c8544ccf92b79317da3380c3e. Each family retains its supplied SIL Open Font License in this directory.
